# Tool catalog

Every tool returns the same evidence envelope:

```json
{ "result": {}, "evidence_id": "ev_…", "evidence": { "kind": "…", "inputs": {}, "artifacts": [], "capturedAt": "…" }, "limitations": [], "unknowns": [] }
```

Results are complete by default; any truncation says why and how to get the rest. Observed, measured, inferred and unknown stay distinct. Large artifacts are referenced by path, never inlined.

| Tool | Shape | CLI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scan_interface` | capture | `uidna scan` |
| `explore_interactions` | capture | `uidna explore` |
| `inspect_dna` | inspect | `uidna inspect` |
| `inspect_element` | inspect | `uidna element` |
| `search_components` | search | `uidna components` |
| `extract_tokens` | workflow | `uidna tokens` |
| `annotate_dna` | mutate | `uidna annotate` |
| `generate_project` | workflow | `uidna generate` |
| `verify_reconstruction` | compare | `uidna verify` |
| `report_reconstruction` | workflow | `uidna report` |
| `export_evidence` | workflow | `uidna export` |
| `reconstruct_interface` | workflow | `uidna reconstruct` |
| _(CLI only)_ | workflow | `uidna setup` — Register the MCP server in Claude Code, Codex and Cursor (prints the plan, asks, backs up) |
| _(CLI only)_ | workflow | `uidna doctor` — Report browser availability, CDP reachability and registration state |
| _(CLI only)_ | workflow | `uidna serve` — Start the MCP server on stdio (what the registered command runs) |

### `scan_interface`

**Scan interface** — shape: `capture` — CLI: `uidna scan <url>`

Capture a page at each viewport: DOM, computed styles filtered to rendering properties, bounding boxes, accessibility tree, fonts, assets, network metadata and one screenshot per viewport. Creates a scan under ./.uidna/<scan-id>/ and returns the base state per viewport. Honors robots.txt and never bypasses access controls.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, not idempotent, reaches the network. Long-running: accepts progress tokens and cancellation.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | no | Public http(s) page to scan with Playwright-launched Chromium. robots.txt is always honored. |
| `cdpEndpoint` | string | no | Attach to your own Chrome started with --remote-debugging-port, e.g. http://localhost:9222. Requires your authorization. |
| `targetId` | string | no | CDP target (tab) id; defaults to the active page. |
| `viewports` | array of integer | no | Viewport widths in CSS pixels. Heights are derived: ≥1200 → 800, ≥700 → 1024, otherwise 844. |
| `budget` | object | no | Per-scan budget. Exhaustion ends the step with partial artifacts and a diagnostic. |
| `headless` | boolean | no | Launch mode only. Default true. |
| `crawl` | object | no | Breadth-first crawl of same-origin links discovered on captured pages. Cross-origin links are recorded, never followed. |
| `captureBodies` | "none" \| "json" | no | Store JSON response bodies of XHR/fetch requests as data assets (redacted, size-capped). Default none. |
| `outRoot` | string | no | Directory that holds scans. Default ./.uidna |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `scanDir`, `target`, `pages`, `states`, `assets`, `budget`, `dnaPath`

### `explore_interactions`

**Explore interactions** — shape: `capture` — CLI: `uidna explore <scanId>`

Try safe interactions on the captured base states of every crawled page (hover, focus, Escape, Tab, clicks on non-submitting buttons, summaries, tabs, disclosure and menu triggers). Records a new state and a transition for every action that changed the page, reverts after each one, and lists every skipped interaction with its reason. Same-origin links to another crawled page are clicked once and recorded as navigation transitions between pages; every other document navigation an action requests is blocked. The safe policy never touches forms; the forms policy also fills each form with synthetic values (never real credentials) and submits it empty and filled to observe validation, with every non-GET request blocked. An action that caused a side effect (a non-GET request, or a navigation off the crawl) is never repeated, in this run or a later run of the same scan. Coverage counts, in total and per page: discovered = visible interactive elements, explored = interactions attempted (including ones the browser refused, listed in explore.json), changed = new states.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, not idempotent, reaches the network. Long-running: accepts progress tokens and cancellation.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `policy` | "safe" \| "forms" | no | "safe" (default) never touches forms. "forms" additionally fills same-origin form controls with synthetic values and submits to observe client-side validation; the submission request itself is blocked and recorded as a side effect. |
| `budget` | object | no | Per-scan budget. Exhaustion ends the step with partial artifacts and a diagnostic. |
| `viewports` | array of integer | no | Subset of the scanned viewports to explore. Default all. |
| `pages` | array of string | no | Subset of page ids to explore. Default all. |
| `denyNames` | array of string | no | Additional accessible-name words that must never be clicked. |
| `formValues` | object | no | Synthetic values per control name or id for the forms policy. Never real credentials. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `policy`, `coverage`, `coverageByPage`, `newStates`, `transitions`, `skipped`, `dnaPath`

### `inspect_dna`

**Inspect DNA** — shape: `inspect` — CLI: `uidna inspect <scanId>`

Summarize the UI DNA document of a scan: counts per facet and which facets have data. Pass a path (dot or JSON-pointer) to read one value, or full=true for the whole validated document. Large sections are summarized by default; nothing is truncated silently.

Effects: read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `path` | string | no | Dot path or JSON pointer into the document, e.g. visual.tokens.colors or /states/items/0. |
| `full` | boolean | no | Return the entire document. |
| `facet` | "app" \| "states" \| "transitions" \| "components" \| "tokens" \| "layout" \| "behavior" \| "assets" \| "limitations" \| "annotations" | no | Return one facet in full. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `dnaVersion`, `dnaPath`, `target`, `summary`, `facets`, `states`, `value`, `document`

### `inspect_element`

**Inspect element** — shape: `inspect` — CLI: `uidna element <scanId> <stateId>`

Return one node of a captured state with its box, filtered computed style, the tokens its values belong to, accessibility properties, ancestors, children and evidence references. Locate it by node id, by role and accessible name, or by a simple selector (#id, .class, tag).

Effects: read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `stateId` | string | yes | State id such as st_01. |
| `nodeId` | string | no |  |
| `role` | string | no |  |
| `name` | string | no | Accessible name (exact, case-insensitive) when locating by role. |
| `selector` | string | no | Simple selector: #id, .class, tag, or tag.class. |
| `nth` | integer | no | Which match to return when several match. Default 0. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `stateId`, `matches`, `node`, `style`, `tokens`, `ancestors`, `children`, `componentInstance`, `evidence`

### `search_components`

**Search components** — shape: `search` — CLI: `uidna components <scanId>`

List component candidates found by fingerprinting (normalized structure + style + role) across the base states, in stable order: match count descending, then fingerprint. Each candidate carries instances, varying props, variants and a confidence derived from structural and style agreement. Naming is left to you.

Effects: read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `minInstances` | integer | no | Default 2. |
| `stateId` | string | no | Restrict instances to one state. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `candidates`, `total`

### `extract_tokens`

**Extract tokens** — shape: `workflow` — CLI: `uidna tokens <scanId>`

Return the token clusters of a scan: colors, typography, font families, font sizes, spacing, radii, shadows and breakpoints. Every token lists its member values with sample counts; values are only merged when the cluster evidence supports it.

Effects: read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `kinds` | array of "color" \| "font-family" \| "font-size" \| "font-weight" \| "line-height" \| "letter-spacing" \| "spacing" \| "radius" \| "shadow" \| "breakpoint" | no | Restrict to some token kinds. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `tokens`, `counts`

### `annotate_dna`

**Annotate DNA** — shape: `mutate` — CLI: `uidna annotate <scanId> <patchesFile>`

Apply your readings to the UI DNA document: name components and tokens, annotate attributed values, authorize assets, add limitations or inferred behavior rules. Every patch is stored with provenance kind "inferred" and source "agent"; measured values are never overwritten. The document is re-validated before it is written.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, not idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `patches` | array of object | yes |  |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `dnaPath`, `applied`, `rejected`, `annotations`

### `generate_project`

**Generate project** — shape: `workflow` — CLI: `uidna generate <scanId> <outDir>`

Generate a deterministic React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Vite project from the UI DNA document: semantic HTML, components extracted from fingerprint matches (with generated names for you to rename), tokens as CSS variables and a Tailwind theme, observed transitions as React state with the same ARIA attributes. Assets that are not authorized become labeled placeholders. Installs (from the npm registry) and builds the project unless told otherwise and returns the paths of the install and build logs. Generated files in outDir are overwritten; other files are kept.

Effects: writes artifacts, destructive, idempotent, reaches the network. Long-running: accepts progress tokens and cancellation.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `outDir` | string | yes | Directory for the generated project. Created if missing; existing generated files are overwritten, other files are kept. |
| `router` | "none" \| "react-router" | no | How pages are wired: "react-router" (default when the document has more than one page) or "none". |
| `behaviorTests` | boolean | no | Also write Playwright tests that replay every recorded transition against the generated app. Default true. |
| `install` | boolean | no | Run npm install. Default true. |
| `build` | boolean | no | Run the production build after install. Default true. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `projectPath`, `files`, `components`, `placeholders`, `mocks`, `install`, `build`

### `verify_reconstruction`

**Verify reconstruction** — shape: `compare` — CLI: `uidna verify <scanId> <outDir>`

Build and serve the generated project, render every base state of every crawled page at its viewport (each page at its generated route), and compare it with the original: pixel diff, SSIM, bounding-box geometry, computed styles, missing or extra elements. Then replay every recorded transition whose source state is reachable by a chain of at most 8 recorded transitions from a base state (locating targets by data-uidna-path, then role and name): clicks, hovers, focus, keys, form fills with the recorded synthetic values, form submits (the request is blocked, as during the scan) and same-origin navigations through the original link, comparing the resulting role-tree change, URL and screenshot. Transitions that caused a side effect are never replayed. With runGeneratedTests, also runs the generated Playwright behavior tests (npm run test:behavior) and reports each result. Returns a DiffReport with one finding per concrete difference, plus regressions and resolved findings relative to the previous attempt.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, not idempotent, local only. Long-running: accepts progress tokens and cancellation.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `outDir` | string | yes | The generated project directory. |
| `viewports` | array of integer | no | Viewport widths in CSS pixels. Heights are derived: ≥1200 → 800, ≥700 → 1024, otherwise 844. |
| `thresholds` | object | no |  |
| `label` | string | no | Free-text label for this attempt, e.g. "after fixing hero spacing". |
| `build` | boolean | no | Rebuild the project before verifying. Default true. |
| `runGeneratedTests` | boolean | no | Also run the generated Playwright behavior tests and report their outcome. Default false. |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`id`, `scanId`, `outDir`, `attempt`, `createdAt`, `thresholds`, `summary`, `visual`, `behavioral`, `regressions`, `resolved`, `previousAttempt`, `limitations`, `unknowns`, `artifacts`

### `report_reconstruction`

**Report reconstruction** — shape: `workflow` — CLI: `uidna report <scanId>`

Render a static HTML report for a scan: side-by-side screenshots with overlays per state and viewport, token tables, component candidates, behavior replay results, the history of every verification attempt (counts, regressions, resolved) with the findings of the latest attempt, and the limitations. No server needed.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `outPath` | string | no | Where to write the HTML. Default <scan dir>/report.html |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `reportPath`, `attempts`, `findings`, `states`

### `export_evidence`

**Export evidence** — shape: `workflow` — CLI: `uidna export <scanId>`

Write a portable evidence bundle for a scan: the UI DNA document, every capture, screenshot, diff report and the evidence ledger, with a manifest of file digests. Secrets are redacted at capture time, so the bundle contains what the scan directory contains.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, idempotent, local only. Returns immediately.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanId` | string | yes | Scan id returned by scan_interface, e.g. scan_20261013_3f9a1c. |
| `outPath` | string | no | Bundle directory. Default <scan dir>/export |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `bundlePath`, `manifestPath`, `files`, `bytes`

### `reconstruct_interface`

**Reconstruct interface** — shape: `workflow` — CLI: `uidna reconstruct <url> <outDir>`

Run the whole Phase 1 loop without an agent: scan → explore (safe) → tokens → generate → verify → report. Returns the DiffReport and the unknowns so you can start repairing. Each step that fails leaves its partial artifacts and is reported; later steps that depend on it are skipped, not faked.

Effects: writes artifacts, non-destructive, not idempotent, reaches the network. Long-running: accepts progress tokens and cancellation.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | no | Public http(s) page to scan with Playwright-launched Chromium. robots.txt is always honored. |
| `cdpEndpoint` | string | no | Attach to your own Chrome started with --remote-debugging-port, e.g. http://localhost:9222. Requires your authorization. |
| `targetId` | string | no | CDP target (tab) id; defaults to the active page. |
| `outDir` | string | yes | Directory for the generated project. |
| `viewports` | array of integer | no | Viewport widths in CSS pixels. Heights are derived: ≥1200 → 800, ≥700 → 1024, otherwise 844. |
| `budget` | object | no | Per-scan budget. Exhaustion ends the step with partial artifacts and a diagnostic. |
| `crawl` | object | no | Breadth-first crawl of same-origin links discovered on captured pages. Cross-origin links are recorded, never followed. |
| `captureBodies` | "none" \| "json" | no | Store JSON response bodies of XHR/fetch requests as data assets (redacted, size-capped); the generator turns them into typed mocks. Default none. |
| `policy` | "safe" \| "forms" | no | Exploration policy: "safe" never touches forms, "forms" fills and submits them with synthetic values, every submission request blocked. Default safe. |
| `explore` | boolean | no | Run exploration. Default true. |
| `install` | boolean | no | Run npm install in the generated project. Default true. |
| `headless` | boolean | no |  |
| `outRoot` | string | no |  |

**Result fields**

`scanId`, `scanDir`, `projectPath`, `dnaPath`, `reportPath`, `diffReport`, `steps`, `findings`
